stationScope.evidence: The current official Stadtwerke Frankfurt (Oder) electromobility page publishes FF-LadeStrom on Stadtwerke-owned charging stations at 0.50 EUR/kWh from 2025-03-01 with a 5.95 EUR monthly fee. Roaming-partner stations are explicitly priced separately at 0.60 EUR/kWh and are excluded from this CPO-direct offer.

note: No blocking fee is encoded because the current official tariff page does not publish one. Roaming-partner pricing remains in the eMSP layer and is never propagated to third-party CPOs.
